label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (first ~30 trials)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2). 93% of its activation mass falls on GO steps whose previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward = 0; firing after a rewarded trial is rare: 0.6% vs 6.8%). It also depends strongly on how far into the episode the trial is: the firing rate is 33% on trial 0 and 18% over trials 0-9, falls to 2% by trials 30-39, and the unit never fires from trial ~45 on. GO & unrewarded-before & ep_trial < 30 gives dev P 0.69, R 0.79, F1 0.74, mass recall 0.91. The strongest activations come from runs of unrewarded trials at the start of an episode. False positives are early unrewarded GO steps where the unit stays silent, often right after a run of rewarded trials. Adding a condition on reward two trials back made the score worse. It is mildly enriched for upcoming switches and for choosing the not-good option, both of which follow from no reward. It is not selective for action, state, or transition type. All predictors are observed by the agent; episode position is not an input, but the agent can track it through its own state.
